title: Boosting Semantic Segmentation by Conditioning the Backbone with Semantic Boundaries (SBCB)
mechanism: Auxiliary semantic-boundary-detection head on multi-scale backbone features, dropped at inference (no cost).
evidence: R: Cityscapes average +1.2 IoU and +2.6 boundary F over several heads and backbones; improves over- and under-segmentation.
adaptation: Boundary targets (2 px) from the 24-class mask, excluding crack (its boundary is itself) or using a 3 px band; aimed at gridline, edge_dark, border, material, inactive edges; attach to ResNet-34 stages 1-4.
min_experiment: Arm house + SBCB head; baseline house; metrics gridline/edge_dark/material IoU and mIoU_rob; kill if mIoU_rob gain < 0.01 and no weak class up >= 0.03.
